requirement.statement: Planning SHALL ask all ready independent decision directions in one bounded batch before asking dependent refinements.

case.given: a decision forest has multiple unresolved roots
case.then: the planner SHALL present the ready roots together within the severity budget

requirement.statement: Planning SHALL materialize a new decision only when its declared multi-decision activation condition is satisfied, then include it in the next topological question batch.

case.given: two independent root decisions select a combination that activates a new concern
case.when: the planner evaluates the completed answer batch
case.then: the new concern SHALL be recorded as a same-level pending decision with provenance and dependencies
